title: Double Randomized and Placebo Controlled Trail of Sanchitongshu Combined Antiplatelet Drug to Prevent Ischemic Stroke
brief_summary: This clinical trail will evaluate the effect of Sanchitongshu combined with antiplatelet drugs (Aspirin or Clopidogrel) in the treatment of high-risk ischemic stroke patients in adults. Half of participants will receive SanchiTongshu and one of antiplatelet drugs (Aspirin or Clopidogrel) in combination, while the other half will receive a placebo and one of antiplatelet drugs (Aspirin or Clopidogrel).
